body.purpose: Dense interface copy and table content.

label.purpose: Buttons, fields, and compact operational headings.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and compact state changes only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clear action in a workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2rem; padding: .25rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); font: inherit; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact supporting action that stays visually quiet.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2rem; padding: .25rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .25rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 400 .8rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2rem; padding: .25rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact textual state with semantic color.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .125rem .375rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(54,196,111,.16); color: var(--color-success); font: 600 .7rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Work Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container for one operational concern.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 .6rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The interface is dense, layered, and controlled: a professional workstation where market state and risk information remain legible without visual noise. Dark tonal layers separate tools and data while a restrained blue accent marks the current action, focus, or selection. The design should feel calm under pressure and familiar to experienced trading users.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, information-rich composition with clear operational hierarchy.
Restrained accent use and explicit semantic state colors.
Flat bordered surfaces separated by tone rather than decoration.
Familiar controls, strong keyboard focus, and tabular numeric alignment.

rules.name: The One Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use #4f9eff for actions, selection, and focus; never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The State Must Read Twice Rule
rules.body: Status meaning must be present in text or iconography as well as color.

rules.name: The Data Holds Still Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for prices, quantities, balances, counts, and changing market values.

rules.name: The Tonal Layers Rule
rules.body: Separate canvas, panel, and control layers with #0f1218, #1a1f2a, and #232a39; do not simulate hierarchy with decorative drop shadows or glass effects.

dos: Do preserve the compact 13px operational scale and established spacing tokens.
Do use Action Blue only for the next action, focus, or current selection.
Do make every onboarding action operate the real ticket and Working Orders surface.
Do keep every first-run step keyboard operable and compatible with reduced motion.
Do explain warnings at the point where they affect submission.
donts: Don't add forced SaaS tours, modal step carousels, decorative celebration, or repeated popups.
Don't create a tutorial mode disconnected from the real trading workflow.
Don't simplify the interface into a consumer investing app or hide meaningful risk.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, accent side stripes, or decorative shadows.
Don't use muted #8a93a6 for critical instructions or required action text.
